<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a resource that's required in order to either cook or smelt items in the [[oven]] or in any [[furnace]]. There are three sources {{PAGENAME}} can be generated from: [[wooden  stick]], [[firewood]], and [[coal]]. Both the oven and the furnaces generate different amounts of {{PAGENAME}} depending on the item used.
